phrases.phrase: The position the add-milpac form starts on. Defaults to 193 (New Recruit). On a roster that does not list this position the form is left unset, and the recruiter can change it on any roster before saving. Set this if a vendor rebuild renumbers the positions.
The rank the add-milpac form starts on. Defaults to 23 (Recruit). The recruiter can still pick a different rank before saving. Set this if a vendor rebuild renumbers the ranks.
The NF/Rosters award granted on each bundled PUC date when a milpac is created. Defaults to 61 (Army & Air Force Presidential Unit Citation). Set this if a vendor rebuild renumbers the award.
The service record type used for the first record written on a new milpac. Defaults to the Transfer type. Set this if a vendor rebuild renumbers the record types.
The user a granted PUC award is attributed to when a milpac is created with no acting visitor (CLI or cron). When there is a session, the acting visitor is used. 0 leaves the vendor default.
Settings for the 7Cav enlistment defaults companion add-on, which grants the standing PUC set and writes the first service record when a milpac is created.
